component.name: PeerChalk
component.summary: Draw and write together, directly between devices

description.p: PeerChalk is a shared whiteboard. Draw with a pen or highlighter, write rich text with LaTeX equations, and work on the same board as other people at the same time.
Devices connect to each other directly, without an account on a server. Your boards stay on your devices, and you can export a board as a PDF.
Desktop and browser versions find each other through the DHT, Nostr, MQTT and PeerJS at once, and a new Network page maps the connections and checks the servers.
Every stroke now shows on busy pages in the browser, browsers find each other through Nostr relays too, and Wacom pen buttons pan and erase.
Devices behind strict networks reach each other through PeerChalk's relay without any setup, and new boards are page boards unless you choose otherwise.
PDFs and large boards reach the others on a board several times faster, and a slow device no longer drops its connection.
Page boards: columns of real-size pages with headings, PDFs to read and write on, and exports page by page at exact sizes.
